<thought>Use a minimal valid silicon CIF (diamond structure) to enumerate all possible (1,1,1) surface slab terminations with the required slab and vacuum thicknesses. The tool will return a JSON dictionary of slabs, which I will then write to a file named slabs.json and provide its path.</thought>
<action>enumerate_slabs_text</action>
<action_input>{
  "bulk_cif": "data_Si
_symmetry_space_group_name_H-M 'Fd-3m'
_cell_length_a 5.43
_cell_length_b 5.43
_cell_length_c 5.43
_cell_angle_alpha 90
_cell_angle_beta 90
_cell_angle_gamma 90
_symmetry_Int_Tables_number 227
_chemical_formula_sum 'Si'
loop_
_atom_site_label
_atom_site_type_symbol
_atom_site_fract_x
_atom_site_fract_y
_atom_site_fract_z
Si Si 0 0 0
Si Si 0.25 0.25 0.25",
  "miller_index": [1, 1, 1],
  "min_slab_size": 12,
  "min_vacuum_size": 5
}
